verdict.rationale: Column documents its own KYC/KYB verifications "with support for manual reviewing" and lets platforms bring their own KYC/KYB, which loosely touches an onboarding review flow and a split of decision ownership. The evidence is a single thin mention and describes none of the queue mechanics the story asks for. Missing for 10: visibility into why an application is pending, a way to supply additional documents, explicit delineation of platform versus bank decisions, any queue or dashboard workflow documentation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can work the onboarding queue — see why an application is pending, supply additional documents, and understand which decisions are mine versus the bank's

citations.quote: Bring your own KYC/KYB process, or use our KYC/KYB verifications with support for manual reviewing.
